claim: Pogba Has Quit The French National Team Over Macron's Remarks on Islam.
justification: High-confidence evidence from both fact-checks indicates that Paul Pogba publicly denied quitting the French national team in October 2020, calling the reports 'fake news,' and his continued representation of France in subsequent matches, including Euro 2020, confirms the claim is false. Macron's remarks on Islam are corroborated, but they did not lead to Pogba's resignation, as shown by Pogba's own statements and documented team participation.
